hero.title:
Breathing is the one thing
we do all day — let's do it well.
hero.subtitle: Toona was built on a simple belief: that conscious breathing is one of the most powerful tools we have, and everyone deserves easy access to it.

mission.title:
Make calm accessible
to everyone.
descriptions: We live in a world that rarely slows down. Stress, distraction, and shallow breathing have become the default. Toona exists to change that — one breath at a time.
We believe that a few minutes of intentional breathing each day can meaningfully improve focus, reduce anxiety, and help people feel more at home in their own bodies.

values.title: What we stand for
values.subtitle: Three principles guide everything we build at Toona.

items.title: Simplicity
items.description: Breathing should feel effortless. We remove friction so you can focus on what matters — the breath itself.

items.title: Science-backed
items.description: Every pattern in Toona is grounded in research. Box breathing, 4-7-8, resonance — these techniques have real, measurable effects.

items.title: Consistency
items.description: One session won't change your life. A daily habit will. We design every feature to help you show up, day after day.

story.title: Born from a personal need.
paragraphs: Toona started as a personal project — a simple tool to practice box breathing before stressful meetings. What began as a few lines of code quickly grew into something more: a full breathing companion that adapts to your pace, your goals, and your life.

It started with a moment of frustration. Instead of letting anger take over, I took a few deep breaths — and it worked. That simple act of conscious breathing changed how I responded to stress. I wanted to build something that made it easy for anyone to do the same.
The little fish in our logo isn't just a mascot. It's a reminder that even underwater, life finds a rhythm. Toona is here to help you find yours.

cta.title: Ready to start breathing better?
cta.description: Download Toona and take your first breath with intention.
